imports.name: NCBI Taxonomy / NCBITaxon
imports.evidence: OBO Foundry registry; source taxonomy labels and hierarchy are mapped into the project module. NCBI acknowledgement and disclaimers: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/
imports.changes: Selected classes, labels and hierarchy; project lineage mapping recorded separately.

imports.name: SILVA ribosomal RNA database, release 138.2 taxonomy
imports.evidence: Canonical taxonomy producer uses the first seven ordered SILVA ranks.
imports.changes: Taxon assignments mapped to NCBI identifiers where supported and otherwise to lineage-scoped project classes; sequencing abundance measurements are project data.

imports.name: Open-Meteo historical weather data
imports.changes: Site-resolved weather observations aggregated to monthly/annual summaries and represented in RDF.
